vectors.title: Out-of-order offline replay with missing parent
preconditions: Owned stream incarnation S1 has steps E10 -> E11 -> E12; capture is stopped.

schedule.action: Upload E12 before its causal parent E11.
Durably retain valid envelope only; its branch projection remains unresolved.
Upload E10 and E11, then replay all three with new receive timestamps.

expected: Exactly one original per event ID and device sequence.
No E12 applied receipt before dependencies resolve; distinct envelope ACK vocabulary requires P0-08.
Final causal edges are E10 -> E11 -> E12 regardless of arrival order.
No missing earlier sequence is acknowledged from a highest-sequence watermark.
Capture remains stopped.

vectors.title: Conflicting member rolls back a batch
preconditions: E10 with stable content C10 is committed at stream S1 sequence 10.

schedule.action: Submit batch containing valid E11 and changed content C10-prime under E10.
Attempt the atomic batch commit.
Reuse S1 sequence 10 under another event ID.

expected: Both conflicting requests fail without changing E10.
E11 from the invalid batch is not committed.
Original bytes and earlier exact ACK are retained.

vectors.title: Parallel branches are not ordered by wall clocks
preconditions: Attempt A1 branch root P is revision 5; two explicitly named branches share P.

schedule.action: Create branch BA child X, captured at 10:00:05Z, parent P.
Create branch BB child Y, captured at 10:00:01Z, parent P.
Receive Y before X.
CAS selected-head revision 5 to BA.
CAS the same selected-head revision 5 to BB.

expected: Both observed originals and explicit branches survive.
Exactly one selected-head CAS wins; the other conflicts.
No X-before-Y or Y-before-X causal edge is inferred from clocks or receive order.
Missing parent is unresolved; cross-user/attempt parent or cycle is invalid.

vectors.title: Undo redo and equal-content ABA
preconditions: Original ink I0 and branch revision 1 exist; job J captured revision 1.

schedule.action: Write I1 as operation O2/revision 2 with I0 as before image.
Erase to I2 at revision 3, then undo to bytes equal to I0 at revision 4.
Fork and redo the referenced earlier operation as revision 5.
Attempt output bound to revision 1 after the screen looks like I0 again.

expected: I0, I1, I2 and undo/redo relations remain recoverable.
Equal bytes do not reuse revision IDs or reduce generations.
J is stale despite visual equality; erase/undo is not privacy deletion.

vectors.title: Visual and structured coverage gaps
preconditions: External app supplies only frames F1 and F4; reference trace has a transient erased step between them.

schedule.action: Record F1 then F4, with unknown interval between them.
Later upload a structured event from another interval with a missing sequence.
Decline to explain the reason for the erase.

expected: Do not fabricate the transient step from F4 or claim an external undo stack.
Coverage remains path-specific; the later event cannot prove the visual gap complete.
Unexpressed reason stays unknown.
Human-reference retention measurement remains a future device check.

vectors.title: Generated assistance and missing or partial receipts
preconditions: Assistance H1 contains card/body/title/audio channels; permission initially allows it.

schedule.action: Generate H1 without dispatch.
Receive a later dispatch H2 but its presentation receipt is lost.
Report only audio segments 1 and 2 of H3 played, remainder unconfirmed.

expected: H1 is generated, not shown.
H2 exposure remains unknown; missing ACK is not proof of unaided work.
H3 records reported played ranges separately from queued/unconfirmed ranges.
Device reports do not prove the user attended or understood the content.

vectors.title: Cached full solution cannot satisfy a narrow request
preconditions: Full solution cache K exists for attempt revision 7 and old help policy 3.

schedule.action: Request only a hint for one step under policy 4.
Find K, then start fresh work bound to attempt revision 7 and policy 4.
Correct that step and say Let me try, advancing attempt and policy revisions.
Finish the old work and queue card, title, diagram, notification, note preview and audio.

expected: K is ineligible for the narrow request even if its source text matches.
Old work cannot publish any channel under the new fence tuple.
No pause, erasure or NAV/WRITE transition independently expands assistance.
Actual semantic leakage needs independent learning/QA review beyond enum checks.

vectors.title: Help revoke and regrant cannot revive old work
preconditions: J binds help generation 8; earlier assistance history is stored.

schedule.action: Withdraw help, committing generation 9.
Make a new explicit help request, committing generation 10.
Try to commit output still bound to generation 8.

expected: J is rejected even though help is allowed again.
Historical assistance remains stored; withdrawing help is not deletion.
Capture state is unchanged unless a separate capture-stop action occurred.

vectors.title: Cross-device revoke races final presentation
preconditions: Server issued one-use authorization D under help generation 8 to client B.

schedule.action: Withdraw help; server durably commits generation 9.
Lose synchronization while holding D and queued audio.
Attempt render/play while disconnected, then reconnect and receive generation 9.

expected: Disconnected or uncertain state blocks new answer-bearing presentation.
After observing generation 9, purge all queued generation-8 channels.
No backend claim of globally instantaneous revocation or completed remote stop before confirmation.
A render preceding local knowledge of withdrawal is a measured distributed race, not erased history.

vectors.title: Attempt-scoped Chinese does not overwrite persistent English
preconditions: Default P5 uses simple English, original technical terms and brief Chinese hints; source and user originals have mixed languages.

schedule.action: Request Chinese for attempt A1 only, creating override O1.
Resume A1 with a different model and load P5 plus O1.
Open different attempt A2 without a new override.
Return delayed A1/O1 content to the now-active A2 surface.

expected: A1 effective language is Chinese within scope; A2 returns to P5.
P5 and all original text/ink remain unchanged.
Late A1/O1 output is not shown on A2.
Whether a repeated attempt shares the same question scope is an explicit P0-08 decision.

vectors.title: Concurrent preference update cannot restore stale scope
preconditions: Device A and offline B both last saw default preference revision 5.

schedule.action: Explicitly change the persistent default with base 5, committing revision 6.
Reconnect and submit an old temporary override or default write based on revision 5.
Finish output bound to the old effective preference tuple.

expected: No last-arrival-wins rewrite of default revision 6.
Stale default CAS conflicts; scope-expired override is not made global.
Old effective-preference output is invalid for current presentation.

vectors.title: Diagnosis correction survives model change
preconditions: Diagnosis D1 cites observed step O3 but its reason is explicitly an inference.

schedule.action: Correct the reason in original language; append statement U1 and diagnosis D2 superseding D1.
Finish a diagnosis update based on D1.
Restart projections and retrieve the attempt under another model.

expected: U1 and original steps remain unchanged and retrievable.
D2 is current; late D1 work cannot restore the old label.
D1 remains historical with superseded status and evidence, not a permanent mastery judgment.
Earliest deviation is evidence-bounded, never absolute across a known gap.

vectors.title: Deletion races upload rebuild replay and receipt
preconditions: Attempt A1 has original operations, diagnosis, help payload, replay receipt and a pending output; independent course source S2 remains retained.

schedule.action: Commit deletion tombstones for A1 and erase its accessible linked payloads.
Upload an A1 operation; replay an old content request; report a late display receipt.
Attempt to rebuild A1 from an old index or queued result.
Regrant unrelated source permission.

expected: No old request, event, rebuild or regrant restores A1 content.
Late receipts may retain only permitted non-content status; no deleted body returns.
Independent S2 originals survive; shared blobs remain only while still referenced.
Remote/object-store/backup cleanup remains pending until separately confirmed.

vectors.title: Crash windows and historical upload
preconditions: A dedicated future test worker receives a process batch while capture is stopped.

schedule.action: Crash before commit, restart, replay.
Commit the replay, crash before its ACK, restart, replay again.
Try final derived write from a stale checkpoint after a later cancellation.

expected: Precommit changes do not survive.
Postcommit replay returns original durable result without duplicating process or incrementing heads.
Stale derived write fails; uncertain external execution is reconciled rather than blindly repeated.
Restored historical data does not restart capture.

vectors.title: More permissive offline intent loses its stale CAS
preconditions: A and B observed help policy revision 4 on the same attempt; B becomes offline.

schedule.action: Commit explicit Let me try as restrictive policy revision 5.
Later deliver a stale full-solution request based on revision 4.
Try to use the old request as permission for a new result.

expected: The old request may be retained as historical user speech but does not apply as current authority.
A more permissive policy transition needs a fresh explicit request/CAS on current scope.
Current restriction and all-channel guard remain until such a request.

vectors.title: Late true exposure is not current presentation permission
preconditions: H1 was reported played under earlier valid permission, but its receipt delivery was delayed.

schedule.action: Withdraw further help without deleting history.
Deliver the authenticated exact late receipt for H1, then duplicate it.
Try using that historical receipt to show H1 again.

expected: Record reported historical exposure once with its original time/uncertainty.
Do not rewrite the historical fact as not helped because permission is now withdrawn.
A historical receipt never authorizes new presentation or automatic requeue.

vectors.title: Assistance facts separate self-correction, hints and solution exposure
preconditions: Three synthetic attempts share a concept but have distinct attempt and step IDs; all original evidence stays immutable.

schedule.action: Correct step A2 before any confirmed presentation within a measured observation window; retain a generated-only unused hint.
Request a local step check and receive only hint segment H1; later correct B2. Keep permitted level and actual H1 extent separate.
Explicitly request a solution, receive solution segments S1/S2, then complete C2. A separate audio dispatch has an unknown remainder.
Read exact request scope, permitted level, presentation receipts/uncertainty, timestamps and attempt/step versions.

expected: Expose observed self-correction, post-hint correction and post-solution completion as distinct supported evidence patterns.
Generated-only/cache/queued/cancelled state does not establish confirmed help; uncertain dispatch or partial playback remains explicitly uncertain.
No pattern automatically proves causal benefit, user attention, or independent mastery; independent transfer requires separate evidence.
Allowed full solution does not mean shown full solution, and permission withdrawal does not erase truthful prior exposure.
Every evidence pattern resolves to exact original attempt/step and content/receipt versions, surviving later diagnosis corrections.
